name: Unidentified proxy 0x6f7a unauthorized balance routing
summary: Implementation 0x338ffeac's selector 0xbfd479c4 let any caller name a token and an amount that the proxy then sold from its own balance on Uniswap V2 with no minimum output, paying the ETH to block.coinbase. The attacker set the amounts to the proxy's whole DAI, WETH and FEI balances, collected the builder refund and backran the skewed pools.
notes: The victim's WETH left too (unwrapped and paid to the block builder alongside the DAI and FEI swap proceeds), so it counts. FEI is priced at DefiLlama's near-par price because the DAI-FEI PSM still redeemed it 1:1; the victim's own forced sale into the thin FEI/WETH pair is not the market price.
